name: seated arm crossover on a chair
description: A seated arm crossover that works the chest and warms up the shoulders.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Open your arms wide to the sides at shoulder height.
Sweep them together so they cross in front of your chest.
Open back out and alternate which arm is on top.
